title: Production certified release-cut registration context repair

phases.objective: Restore workflow registration by resolving runner-local evidence paths only after runner allocation.

e2e_journeys.actor: GitHub Actions workflow registrar and certified release validator
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A trusted same-repository validation pull request targets a governed certified-release base branch.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The workflow registers jobs, initializes evidence paths from RUNNER_TEMP at step runtime, and preserves the immutable validation contract.
steps: Parse the workflow without evaluating runner context at job scope.
Export evidence paths through GITHUB_ENV from RUNNER_TEMP.
Run the unchanged validation, evidence, and no-mutation checks.
assertions: No finalize job-level environment value references runner context.
Both evidence paths are initialized in a runtime step.
The pull_request_target selector and direct ARM validation jobs remain unchanged.
No deployment, migration, provider call, credential payload read, or Production mutation is introduced.

phases.objective: Observe registration and exact-head evidence publication across Draft and Ready validation cycles.
Keep registration fail-closed without reintroducing job-level runner context.
Prove a bounded same-repository validation cycle on the repaired workflow.
Use the repaired validator only through the existing governed certified-release path.
